text:
ara: Quick heads-up 1: PR #4890 touches the migration guide and updates Python + TS SDK snippets. Main changes: unify param names (model -> model_version), rename 'request id' -> 'request_identifier', and tighten wording. Planning to merge in tomorrow morning window but need two approvals and a clean preview.

felix: I can review the TS snippets. One question: do we need to standardize env var names now (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY)? We recently said REDWOOD_API_KEY in the style doc.

zoe: Tone note: switch how-to steps to imperative voice. Replace "You can run" / "Users should" with "Run" / "Use". Also avoid passive sentences in step lists.

ara: Yep, converted the steps to imperative and removed hedging language ("we recommend"). Added a short sentence explaining why pinning model_version helps reproducibility.

toni: CI update: preview deployed but linkcheck shows a 404 at /guides/auth#sdk. Left a comment on the PR.

ara: I pushed an anchor fix and a temporary redirect, but docs preview still reports linkcheck fail on the upstream worker. Might be cache.

docs-bot: [preview] docs-ci.redwood.ai/builds/4890  deployed (staging). Status: linkcheck failed; markdown-lint: 1 warning.

felix: On JS naming: policy is snake_case for API payloads, camelCase for client options. We should document that in the snippet conventions so readers aren't confused.

zoe: Good call. Add a brief "Snippet conventions" callout: server payload keys -> snake_case; client SDK options -> camelCase (JS) or snake_case (Python).

ara: Done. I also updated the Python examples to use RedwoodClient and the explicit method name text_generate(...). Replaced any uses of client.generate().

toni: Also standardize error-handling examples. Replace generic Exception with RateLimitError in Python and show exponential backoff. Same pattern for JS (try/catch + backoff).

ara: Adding the Python retry example here for review:

```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
from redwood.errors import RateLimitError
import time

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=KEY)
for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        resp = client.text_generate(model_version=\"rwd-v1\", input=\"Summarize this\")
        break
    except RateLimitError:
        time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
        continue
```

felix: That looks good. I noticed one import still says "from redwood import Client" in a TS example that was converted to Python; I'll inline-fix it.

ara: I'll include the import fix in this PR rather than a separate follow-up so the change set is atomic.

zoe: Two small wording nits: change "metadata" example keys to snake_case in Python snippets (e.g., request_identifier) and add a short comment in examples explaining why we pin model_version to a specific version.

ara: Done on both counts. I added a one-line rationale under the code samples.

toni: Re: merge timing  do we want this before tonight's v0.9.0 cut? If so we need approvals + a green preview at least two hours before cut.

ara: Prefer to land earlier today by 17:00 PT. If reviews aren't finished, plan B: morning merge window 08:30-09:30 PT and I'll trigger a clean preview build there.

docs-bot: PR #4890  reviewers requested: felix, zoe. CI: linkcheck failing.

felix: I'll prioritize the TS review and aim to approve before 16:30 PT. If I find tiny typos I'll push a small follow-up patch.

ara: Thanks. Summary of merge constraints: 1) felix and zoe approvals, 2) docs-bot preview green (linkcheck & md-lint), 3) merge not within 2 hours of release cut unless emergency. I'll update the PR description with the style rationale and checklist. Hold merge until conditions met.
